seasonal_colour: Introduced at panel 6 only. Orange: southbound autumn (Outbound); magenta: northbound spring (Inbound).
events: Complete candidate journeys from journey_journeys (departure-arrival); candidate stops from journey_stops. Departure/arrival markers are the first/last displayable estimate inside each interval.
extraction: Displayable estimates inside complete journey intervals, excluding estimates inside candidate stop intervals. Quality-mask, 36-hour, cycle and stop breaks are preserved.

smoothing.selected: A: cubic Bezier links between land-constrained regional anchors (make_lane_geometry)
smoothing.A: Endpoints fixed at regional anchors; bends are design choices; widths scale with journey counts.
smoothing.B: Per journey: smooth.spline (spar 0.8) of longitude and latitude against time, 60 steps, journeys with at least 8 travelling estimates. Per season: median longitude per journey in 2-degree latitude bins, mean within bird, equal bird weight, at least 3 birds, weighted smooth.spline (spar 0.65); written to breakdown-smoothing.csv.
smoothing.reason: B follows the data but its seasonal means stop where bin support ends and average divergent spring routes into one line; A keeps meaningful endpoints and separates the spring lanes.

exploratory_view: EPSG:3857; 0–72N, A4 frame centred on 17W. Panel 7 panes are half-width crops of the same frame. Full-coverage north-up relief is cached independently in breakdown_relief.
meaning: Design-decision sequence, not literal render-call order.
